lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish... * * Spongebob square pants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * ready? Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants!
Daddy's going to make it all right.
Mister Krabs, what's wrong with pearl?
Her scurvy prom date stood her up, boy And she can't seem to find another.
That's because there's only one fish in the sea As long, tan and handsome as he is... and that's him!
Do you know what that would do to my complexion?
People will mistake me for a planetarium.
I don't know... but i can't take him, daddy.
They'll kick me off the most frequently pictured in the yearbook committee.
We've got to find someone else.
Listen up! Which one of you lucky lubbers wants to take Me lovely daughter pearl to the prom?
Now listen, boy, i'm a-Counting on you To make this a very special night For a very special girl.
Remember, you're doing it for good old mr...
Are you talking to that dummy i made?
I made this part out of...
You're taking pearl to her prom.
Oh, Gary, i'm a prom failure.
I couldn't even get a date for my own junior prom.
No, that was Patrick who brought his mom.
Besides, how am i supposed to compare With pearl's old boyfriend Mr. Long, tan and handsome?
This magazine gives me an idea.
Okay, Gary, wait till pearl Gets an eyeful of this!
Cleans up pretty good, doesn't he?
Well, at least no one will recognize you.
I just want to get through this With my social status intact.
I want to go to the prom, get my picture taken And i want to dance...
And don't do that other thing You're always doing...
Uh, pearl, we got to get to the limo.
I can't afford to break in a new fry cook! Har-Har-Har...
Well, i guess the first thing we should do is...
Uh... go get me some punch!
I'd like you to meet billy fishkins.
And you know brian flounder From math class.
So... like, where's your date, pearl?
He's over at the punch bowl getting me some punch.
Ooh, is he the really tall one?
Oh, quick, let's go see how ugly cindy's dress is.
It's my ex-Boyfriend, octavius rex A.K.A. Long, tan and handsome.
Whoa... but i bet he isn't holder Of the regional romantic dance championship trophy.
Can't you see everybody here is doing the whack?
Oh, yeah, i invented that one.
Are you sure you can do this?
Well, i guess you can take me home now.
Don't cry... the prom expert is here.
Hey, we can still... no, i broke that.
Wow, what did you do to him?
Don't worry, Spongebob-- You didn't mess everything up.
Actually, it was pretty funny When that hot dog landed in judy's hair.
But i am having a good time.
You know, we haven't finished our dance yet.
Yes, you can still wear the wig.
I'm going to teach you how to do the sponge.

* well, if you take your leg and you stick it in the air * * and then you take the other one and jam it right up there * * you twist yourself around and give a great big lunge * * now you're doing the sponge * huh, do the sponge, sponge, oh, do the sponge * * bet your buns you're doing the sponge * * well, now, first you take your leg * * and you stick it in the air * and then you take the other one * Oh, oh, oh...! * and you jam it right up there... * Meep, meep.
Can't you see i'm doing the sponge?

* ...a big lunge * now you're doing, yeah, now you're doing the sponge * * all right now, yeah, do the sponge, sponge * * oh, do the sponge * before you know, you're taking the plunge * * i said the sponge, sponge, oh, do the sponge * * bet your buns you're doing the sponge * * yeah, bet your buns you're doing the sponge * * oh, yeah, well, you're doing the sponge * * oh, i said the sponge, sponge, yeah, do the sponge * * yeah, do the sponge, sponge... * They love us!
Go wreck someone else's prom, will you?
I'm sorry tonight didn't turn out like you planned.
I knew it would be a total disaster all along.
But as far as disasters go That was really fun.
Keep away from my precious flower!
Well, goodnight, short, yellow and spongy.
Do you know what today is?
Today's the beginning of the judging For employee of the month.
Spongebob, don't you know that award is a scam?
Mister Krabs gives you that award So you'll work harder for no extra money.
He gives it to me because i work harder.
You could win it, too, if you tried harder.
To get my face on the wall of shame?
Squidward, you've got it all wrong.
Having pride in your work is nothing to be ashamed of.
Why, it's the only thing that makes it all worthwhile.
This is going to be a tough one, though.
Watch out, Spongebob-- Squidward appears to be on the verge of a breakout.
There might be a new face on the wall this month.
I might sneak up on you.
How could i have let the quality of my work slip so much?
Don't you know that award is a load of...
Please, don't tell Mister Krabs about this.
It'll hurt my chances of winning the award.
I already told you, that award is a bunch of...
Like this hat, the award is a symbol of...
It's a symbol that you're a chump.
And this is a symbol of what i think Of the employee of the month award!
An experienced employee of the month Always keeps a brick of lead in his hat.
I'm telling you for the last time That award is nothing but a joke.
What if the award is a phony?
Does this mean my whole body of work is meaningless?
Stow that kind of talk, sailor.
That's exactly what he wants you to think.
This is no time to go lily-Livered on us.
There's no room for "buts" in war, soldier.
He's trying to trick you, get inside your mind.
You must stop at nothing-- And i mean nothing-- To defeat him.
Have i made myself clear, private?
He can't go to work if he doesn't wake up.
You can't win that award if you don't get up for work.
If i really wanted that award I could win it with my tentacles tied.
Maybe so, but i did win employee of the month 26 months in a row.
Are y... are you trying to say that you are better than me?
I've been better than you for 26 months-- And it'll be 27 tomorrow.
Oh, that's it, square-For-Brains, that's it!
I'm going to show you How easy it is to win that award.
I'm going to be the new employee of the month.
I will prove to you i am far more competent than you.
Well, i'm going in early to wax the floors.
I'll have done it by the time you get there.
You'll have to get up early to get there before me.
I don't need the sleep... loser.
I'm going to wring you dry when i get out of here.
Now, get me out of here.
Don't want to look tired for my employee of the month photo.
Spongebob, i can't take it anymore.
If we keep this up, neither of us will win the award.
We should save our energy for work Where we really need it.
Okay, let's have a good, clean fight.
And may the better man win.
He's nothing but a lying, boneless, ink-Squirting, big-Nosed phony.
Look at that buck-Toothed, corn-Fed smile.
You can't trust him as far as you can throw him.
As soon as he stops shaking my hand...
I'm going to make a run for it.
* money, money, going to make some money... *
Ah, it warms me wallet to see me employees coming in so early.
It's more efficient To clean dishes this way, Mister Krabs.
Flowers and chocolates for you, Mister Krabs!
Look, i'm putting my own money into the register, Mister Krabs!
Two spatulas to increase productivity, Mister Krabs!
There's nothing to this patty flipping, Mister Krabs.
I'll easily double your output, sponge hog!
Hey, look at that, krabby patties!
Wait, you've got to pay for those.
So, who's the winner of employee of the month? Me, me, me...!
